newsitem.title: FINLAND: ARCTOS SAYS BUYS 49 PCT OF SANTA MONICA.
newsitem.headline: ARCTOS SAYS BUYS 49 PCT OF SANTA MONICA.

text.p: Finnish investment house Arctos Capital Oy said in a statement on Thursday it bought 49.3 percent of data company Santa Monica Software Finland Oy from Olivetti Oy, part of Italian information technology group Olivetti .
The purchase price paid by Arctos Capital was 33.3 million markka, it said.
In addition, Santa Monica managing director Tapani Kurki bought 10.7 percent of Santa Monica. From before, Kurki owned 40 percent of Santa Monica, Arctos Capital said.
The parties agreed that the majority of Santa Monica will be transferred to Arctos Capital by the end of 1999.
Santa Monica's 1996 net sales were around 110 million markka, up from 66 million in 1995, and pre-tax profit around 20 million markka compared to 10.7 million in 1995, Arctos Capital said.
For Arctos Capital, the purchase was "a logical part of the company's new focussed investment policy," it said.
